description: Lone Survivor: The Director's Cut (Superflat Games, GOG v1.0 build 21178, via Proton)
long: Lone Survivor is a 2D psychological survival horror game following a masked protagonist navigating a city overrun by infected creatures. Players manage scarce food, ammunition and sanity while exploring side-scrolling environments and deciding when to fight or sneak past enemies. The Director's Cut adds new areas, items and endings to the original release.
